summary: The prepared source already aligns LongLive2 requests to complete causal latent blocks. The checked-in longlive2_i2v request is 61 output frames, mapping to 16 latent frames and two blocks of 8. A focused reconstruction shows the reported invalid state only when the LongLive2-specific adjustment is bypassed, so no production source change is justified.
